evidence: The paper focuses entirely on comparing predictive performance of classification algorithms using ROC curves, precision-recall curves, and AUC metrics. No variable importance measures are reported or discussed. Section 2.2 describes the Random Forest and XGBoost algorithms; Sections 3.2–3.2.2 present results exclusively as ROC/PR curves and AUC values with bootstrap-test significance; Section 4 discusses algorithm performance trade-offs. No feature importance, feature ranking, or Gini/MDI values appear anywhere in the text.
